body:
I think that the first problem is fixed in master. Take a look at 

https://gist.github.com/petebacondarwin/5e7c6814ef046bd14be3#file-angular2-d-ts-L2354
I think this is totally fixed with the SHA @petebacondarwin mentioned. Closing.
@misko there is still the issue of getters having `void` return type. But I looked at the AST that TypeScript generates and I don't see any better type information...

Yep, those are still in, also this file introduces a number of "implicit any types" that weren't there in the previous version ... 

```
4297 Error TS7005 Variable 'PUBLIC' implicitly has an 'any' type.
4301 Error TS7005 Variable 'undefinedValue' implicitly has an 'any' type.
4295 Error TS7005 Variable 'PUBLIC_AND_PRIVATE' implicitly has an 'any' type.
4299 Error TS7005 Variable 'PRIVATE' implicitly has an 'any' type.
  60 Error TS7005 Variable 'ON_PUSH' implicitly has an 'any' type.
1232 Error TS7005 Variable 'DOCUMENT_TOKEN' implicitly has an 'any' type.
4127 Error TS7005 Variable 'DEFAULT_VISIBILITY' implicitly has an 'any' type.
  66 Error TS7005 Variable 'DEFAULT' implicitly has an 'any' type.
3205 Error TS7005 Variable 'appComponentTypeToken' implicitly has an 'any' type.
  26 Error TS7019 Rest parameter 'args' implicitly has an 'any[]' type.
3560 Error TS7006 Parameter 'T' implicitly has an 'any' type.
  26 Error TS7013 Construct signature, which lacks return-type annotation, implicitly has an 'any' return type.
```
@mhevery maybe I will look into angular more so I can start fielding some of these :)
